summary: Market mood is broadly risk-off: a stronger US dollar, higher Treasury yields, renewed Fed hike expectations, and a technology selloff are weighing on equities and crypto. Bitcoin is testing the $64,000–$65,000 area, while oil is pressured by expected supply surplus; gold is attempting a modest rebound from recent lows.[3][4][5]
